fuente.titulo: Pope Leo receives Bob Dylan at the Vatican

titular: Pope Leo XIV welcomes Bob Dylan to Vatican
bajada: Nobel laureate singer, touring Italy, met the Pontiff at the Apostolic Palace
caption: Pope Leo XIV received Bob Dylan, the American singer-songwriter and Nobel laureate in literature, at the Apostolic Palace during his Italian tour. The Pope had previously quoted Dylan's lyrics in the preface to a book on disarmament. Source: Vatican News, Nov 4, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: The grand facade of the Apostolic Palace at dusk, a small figure in papal white visible in the upper right, left and center of the frame left open and quiet.
